answer_4.quote: At the end of each BIOASQ annual contest, the biomedical experts who prepared the questions and their gold documents and snippets inspect the responses of the participants. If any of the documents and snippets returned by the participants are judged relevant to the corresponding questions, they are added to the gold responses.... A first striking observation ... that all results improve substantially after expert inspection, i.e., all systems retrieved many relevant documents and snippets the experts had missed.
answer_4.guideline: Experts inspected system responses and judged whether returned documents and snippets were relevant to the questions.
